articles.title: Man critically injured in Mississauga stabbing. 1 suspect in custody, 1 other at large
articles.summary: Peel Regional Police have one person in custody and are searching for a second suspect after a man was stabbed in Mississauga on Sunday evening. articles.title: Brampton gas leak forces some residents to evacuate their homes
articles.summary: Residents of a street in Brampton were evacuated from their homes early Sunday evening due to a gas leak in the city’s Madoc area. Emergency crews were called to Seaborn and Bingham Roads just before 5 p.m. for reports of a gas leak at the back of a residential unit. All homes on the street […]

articles.title: Montrealer reunited with cat after 16-day separation at Toronto Pearson airport
articles.summary: The 16-day-long nightmare came to an end for Montrealer Abir Batikhi as her missing cat is returned home safe and sound. Caramel, a seven-year-old feline, who was lost on the grounds of Toronto Pearson airport for over two weeks, left to fend for herself in a situation that grew more dire with every passing day. […]

articles.title: ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’ makes it 6 weeks in a row at No. 1 as Hollywood wraps a banner summer
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” remained the No. 1 movie in theaters over the weekend, becoming just the second film this decade to top the box office for six straight weeks.

articles.title: Suspect wanted in more than 30 vehicle break-ins in Mississauga
articles.summary: Police in Peel Region have released photos of a suspect wanted in connection with at least 32 vehicle break-ins in Mississauga.

articles.title: 6,000-plus U of T admin and technical staff in legal strike position starting Tuesday
articles.summary: More than 6,100 administrative and technical staff at the University of Toronto will be in a legal strike position on Tuesday, the first day students are set to return to class.

articles.title: One person seriously injured in Richmond Hill home invasion shooting
articles.summary: Police in York Region are searching for an unknown number of suspects following a home invasion and shooting in Richmond Hill early Sunday morning. articles.title: Blue Jays claim catcher Shawn Ross off waivers from Mets
articles.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays claimed catcher Shawn Ross off waivers from the New York Mets on Saturday. Ross was then optioned to triple-A Buffalo.

articles.title: Woman, 82, dead after she was struck, run over in Scarborough: Toronto police
articles.summary: Toronto police say an 82-year-old woman is dead following a collision in Scarborough Friday.

articles.title: 2 men dead after car hits traffic light pole, knocks it down in North York: Toronto police
articles.summary: Toronto police say two men are dead following a single-vehicle collision in North York overnight.

articles.title: Man charged with arson after cars torched outside Liberal MP's home: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say they have arrested and charged a man in connection to an arson investigation after several cars were torched at the home of a Scarborough MP last week.

articles.title: NDP takes Scarborough Southwest, PCs win in York—Simcoe, Hamilton East—Stoney Creek byelections
articles.summary: Ontario's Progressive Conservatives held onto the ridings of York-Simcoe and Hamilton East-Stoney Creek, while the NDP maintained its grip on Scarborough Southwest in three provincial byelections held Thursday.
